Summary:

Private Beach-100 Yard Walk, Private Heated Pool, 4 Bikes, 1 Set of FREE beach chairs - `Grayt Reflections West`



The Space:

🏖 Grayt Reflections West – Gulf-View Escape with Private Heated Pool!



✨ QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:

✔ Gulf Views – Stunning beachfront scenery from the living room & balconies

✔ Quick Walk to the Beach – Private community access just 100 yards away

✔ Fully Renovated Outdoor Living Space – Large sectional, big-screen TV & more!

✔ Private Heated Pool – Available for $50/day or $350/week

✔ Cozy Open Concept – Bright & airy, perfect for relaxing & entertaining

✔ 4 Adult Bikes Included – Cruise 30A’s scenic trails & explore Grayton Beach

✔ Gas Grill – Enjoy outdoor cookouts with family & friends

✔ Lounging Hammocks – The perfect spot for reading & unwinding

✔ Driveway Parking for 2 Cars – Hassle-free & convenient

✔ FREE beach chairs - 1 Set Beach Chairs - seasonally March - October



🏠Welcome to Grayt Reflections West



Nestled in the quiet neighborhood of Gulf Trace in Grayton Beach, Grayt Reflections West is a cozy 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom duplex that will allow guests to relax and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. Gulf Trace is surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park property on three sides and the Gulf of Mexico to the south, providing a quiet beach getaway you won't want to leave. With the community's private beach access going to the beach is a breeze with a short 100 yard walk. This unit is eloquently decorated in neutral colors with hints of blue. This beautiful home offers dazzling 30a beachfront views from the living room and the balconies. Enjoy the ease of entertaining your family and friends with the homes open kitchen, dining and living room. When you're ready to hit the beach, hop on one of the 4 bikes provided to splash and enjoy the warm Florida sun! At the end of the day, relax in the living room and watch the beautiful sunset over the Gulf of Mexico. Check availability and book today!



House Rules

**No Pets!**

**No Smoking!**

**No Parties!**

**The primary renter must be at least 25 years old**

**No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25**

**30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**





* Pool heat max temperature is 82 degrees

* Fee $50 per day / $350 per week

* Heating applies to the entire stay, but can be added after arrival

* Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st

* If you love this unit, be sure to check out Grayt Reflections East Please note, the East and West units share a balcony that are separated by a gate. Renting both units would give you 8 bedrooms and room for 20 people

* No Cable. Streaming Only

* Please note as of January 1, 2022, HOA prohibits the use of golf carts in the community of Gulf Trace



SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (10):

Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo

Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower

Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower

Bunk Room: Twin over Full Bunk Bed and Twin Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower



AREA ATTRACTIONS:

Take home a piece of Grayton Beach by picking up a painting or sculpture from the Grayton Artist Collective; or, stop at a boutique like Petunia’s to browse a number of gifts and treasures. Escape from it all with a hike through Grayton Beach State Park — from here, the sight of sand dunes will leave you in awe.

At the end of the day, stroll along this beach neighborhood’s sugar-white sand and watch the sunset. Grab a memorable meal at favorites like Coast or Hurricane Oyster Bar & Grill, and then listen to some live music at Red Bar or AJ's Resturant. The property sits halfway between the new Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport in Panama City and Northwest Florida Regional Airport in Fort Walton Beach.  With multiple American, Delta, United/Continental and Southwest flights daily, Grayton Beach is easy to get to from anywhere.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
